tracing.evaluation_cohort_validation: Evaluated on the exact same Validation predictions (In-Sample)
tracing.evaluation_cohort_test: Evaluated on Historical Diagnostic Test predictions (Out-of-Sample)

in_sample_ece_explanation.finding: The reported validation ECE of 0.0000 is an in-sample mathematical artifact of non-parametric isotonic regression.
in_sample_ece_explanation.mathematical_mechanism: Isotonic regression fits a piecewise constant monotonic step function directly minimizing squared error on (p_raw, y_val). When 10 quantile or uniform bins are evaluated on the exact same fitting data, empirical conditional expectations within bins match predicted bin means, collapsing ECE to zero.
in_sample_ece_explanation.verdict: MISLEADING_IF_CLAIMED_AS_GENERALIZATION. In-sample ECE = 0.0000 must never be interpreted as proof of perfect calibration in unseen production traffic.

task_a_calibration_audit.safest_future_calibration_evaluation: Use K-fold out-of-fold calibration on training/validation splits, or evaluate calibration strictly on a dedicated, unblinded holdout cohort without reusing historical test sets.

reported_capacity_5_pct.explanation: Stage 3.4 selected operating points using min(abs(volume - target)), which allowed an operating point of 5.76% to be labeled as the 5% capacity point. In production, review capacity is a hard upper bound.

corrected_hard_capacity_operating_points.deterministic_rule: Filter sweep points satisfying volume_pct <= capacity_limit; select candidate maximizing True Positives / Recall; break ties by highest precision, then highest threshold.

correlation_audit.independence_assessment: Positive correlation disproves conditional independence. Furthermore, zero correlation would be insufficient to prove independence. The theoretical assumption of raw Noisy-OR is empirically violated.

max_risk_heuristic.audit_note: Uncalibrated ranking heuristic. Appropriate for queue sorting, invalid as posterior fraud probability.

raw_noisy_or.audit_note: Violates independence assumption; systematically over-predicts risk.

calibrated_noisy_or.audit_note: Monotonic Isotonic scaling aligns validation empirical frequencies. Must be validated on unseen future holdout before live routing.

v2_2_protocol_specification.censoring_rule: Orders placed after maturity cutoff are strictly excluded from return-fraud training/evaluation.

access_control_architecture.prediction_commitment: Model developers must commit SHA-256 hash of their predictions array (sha256(predictions.npy)) to the audit log before label decryption key is released.
access_control_architecture.unblinding_gate: Single-use unblinding gate managed by Independent Auditor.
access_control_architecture.post_unblinding_rule: Strict freeze on model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and threshold adjustments once unblinded.

leakage_risks_identified: Risk of static entity overlap if random seed 42 is reused without entity rotation.
Need to verify cross-split graph leakage on rolling relationship projections.

inconsistencies_catalog.issue: Misleading Capacity Constraint Label (5% Budget achieved 5.76%)
inconsistencies_catalog.description: Stage 3.4 labeled threshold 0.13 as the 5% capacity operating point, but achieved volume was 5.76% (699 orders), exceeding the 5.0% ceiling by 93 orders.
inconsistencies_catalog.remediation: Corrected hard capacity cutoff is t = 0.15, achieving 3.93% volume (477 orders) and strictly complying with the <= 5.0% constraint.

inconsistencies_catalog.issue: In-sample ECE = 0.0000 reported without explicit in-sample qualifier
inconsistencies_catalog.description: Validation ECE was reported as 0.0000 without explicitly noting that the Isotonic calibrator was evaluated in-sample on its own fitting data.
inconsistencies_catalog.remediation: Report discrimination (ROC/PR-AUC) and calibration (Brier/ECE) with explicit cohort separation: In-Sample Validation ECE (0.0000) vs Out-of-Sample Test ECE (0.0289).

inconsistencies_catalog.description: Report noted Pearson r = 0.2533 as disproving independence, but did not formally clarify that even zero correlation is insufficient to establish conditional independence.
inconsistencies_catalog.remediation: Document that conditional independence P(not A and not B) = P(not A)P(not B) is violated both linearly and non-linearly due to ring co-occurrence.
